verdict.rationale: Kling documents image-to-video generation and video generation that takes video input, including reference-driven video and video-input pricing tiers. It also describes a multimodal framework that treats image and video as input modalities, and Motion Control. However, nothing explicitly documents using a reference image or video as a style reference that new footage then adopts, so the 'in that style' part is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit style-reference/style-transfer documentation, detail on how reference video inputs shape output style, independent or hands-on corroboration.
